$comment: Machine-readable source of truth for the mods Trance reimplements. See TRANCE.md section 8. Verified 2026-08-24 against sineorg/store marketplace.json and zen-browser.github.io/theme-store/themes.json. Phase 3 (surfaces) landed 2026-08-24; Phase 4 (sidebar-tabs) 2026-08-25; Phases 5 (chrome-furniture + icons) and 6 (motion-feedback) 2026-08-25. Two verdicts were changed by their investigations: mod 7 NATIVE->ZEN, mod 14 NATIVE->DEFER. See investigationDoc fields. Phase 7 (2026-08-26) preinstalled mods 9 and 23 rather than reimplementing them (ADR-030), changing two more verdicts NATIVE->PREINSTALL; phase 8 (2026-08-26) landed mod 3 as TranceTheme (ADR-031); phase 10 (2026-08-26) preinstalled mod 13 rather than reimplementing it (ADR-033), changing a fifth verdict NATIVE->PREINSTALL and making it the first mod Trance installs from the Zen theme store rather than the Sine store. Phase 9 (2026-08-26) installed the seven extensions below through src/zen/trance/distribution/policies.json (ADR-032); their installUrl fields mirror that file and it is the one owner of the list. Mod 2 was moved NATIVE->PREINSTALL on 2026-08-27 (ADR-049) and is the first mod Trance installs straight from an author's repository rather than from either marketplace.

verdictLegend.ADAPT: Permissive license (MIT/Apache-2.0). Code may be ported with attribution and license retention.
verdictLegend.ZEN: Stock Zen already provides this; configure rather than build.
verdictLegend.PREINSTALL: Trance installs the author's own distribution rather than reimplementing it. Used where a reimplementation could only ever approximate someone else's drawing and the licence forbids copying it (ADR-024, ADR-027), and where the mod owns no element Trance owns, so reimplementing it would remove no conflict and cost what the original costs (ADR-030), and where the mod owns nothing Trance owns and costs almost nothing, so there is neither a conflict to remove nor a cost to cut (ADR-033).

stores.github: the author's own repository, installed by path rather than from a marketplace index

mods.name: Advanced Tab Groups
mods.notes: Near-total overlap with stock Zen folders: grouping, subfolders, icon picker and collapsed-with-active-tab are all zen-folder's. Firefox already owns tab-group colour, palette and persistence (TabGroupState). Trance adds a colour submenu on Zen's #zenFolderActions and a section-style header. MIT permits adapting; nothing needed adapting.

mods.name: Better New Tab button
mods.notes: Verdict changed NATIVE->PREINSTALL (ADR-049). Trance kept only B1, the unlabelled centred plus, and dropped the radius sliders most people install it for - which left the button with two owners and a user with a third of a mod. Trance preinstalls the author's own distribution instead and ships no new-tab-button rules at all. Published to neither marketplace: the provisioner installs it straight from the repository, as Sine does.

mods.name: BetterZenGradientPicker
mods.notes: Builds on Zen's own gradient engine (zen.theme.gradient.*). Clean-room: unlicensed, so no source was read. TranceTheme extends Zen's picker in place - lightness slider, gradient-angle knob, palettes, saved themes and hex entry - by wrapping methods on gZenThemePicker rather than editing it, so phase 8 adds no upstream touchpoint (ADR-031).

mods.name: Context Menu Icons
mods.notes: Was the icon cluster's source: MIT, both packs copied verbatim and the ~270-selector mapping adapted with every !important stripped. ADR-039 removed all of it — Trance ships no icon pack, so nothing from this mod is in the tree. Its item-hiding, fold-menu script and bookmark-bar extras were dropped earlier.

mods.name: Customize Collapsed Sidebar
mods.notes: Landed as the collapsed rail in TranceTabStrip. Defaults are the user's own mod.ccs.* values. Zen's rail sizing is !important on :root; Trance redeclares the consuming variables on #navigator-toolbox instead (ADR-015).

mods.name: Deta Loading Bar
mods.notes: Rebuilt on nsIWebProgressListener rather than adapted. The MIT original shows four of the eight failure modes at once: infinite animation, animating width (a layout property) at display rate, a per-frame filter: blur(), and a permanently promoted .browserStack. Fourteen prefs became three.

mods.name: Floating Status Bar
mods.notes: Verdict changed from NATIVE to ZEN by investigation: zen.theme.styled-status-panel already floats the status panel and is on by default on macOS. No Trance code; the Zen pref is surfaced on the Trance settings page.

mods.name: Hide Extension Name
mods.notes: Three lines of CSS. Trance writes the same rule without the !important a userChrome sheet needs. MIT recorded anyway.

mods.name: Live Calendar
mods.notes: Verdict changed NATIVE->PREINSTALL by its investigation (ADR-030). The one always-armed timer is a 60s ICS refresh, which is exactly the budget phase 7's own acceptance criterion set for a replacement; the 1Hz countdown lives only while a reminder popup is on screen. It owns no element Trance owns, so there is no second owner to remove.

mods.name: Nebula
mods.notes: GPL-3.0 — absolutely no code copying. User requires it in full. Ships as the default surface preset.

mods.name: New Icons
mods.notes: Contributes a coverage requirement — the icon set must reach the toolbar, panels and the site-information panel — and no assets. Unlicensed, so nothing was taken; the glyphs come from Context Menu Icons' MIT packs.

mods.name: Nova UI
mods.notes: Phase 3 landed the flat preset's geometry; Phase 5 landed the panel and menu spacing, radius, edges and scrollbars, all from tokens that already existed. Its mute-button visualiser (an infinite animation), custom font and essentials flattening were dropped.

mods.name: Pimp your PiP
mods.notes: 88 lines of CSS over the Picture-in-Picture player, no script and no timer. Trance loads no stylesheet in that window, so there was no second owner to remove and no cost to cut; verdict changed NATIVE->PREINSTALL by the investigation (ADR-033). The theme-store repository is MIT but carries no per-theme licence, so the mod itself is unlicensed and is installed, not copied.

mods.name: Render.js
mods.notes: Verdict changed from NATIVE to DEFER by investigation, answering TRANCE.md §16 Q8. Each of its five behaviours duplicates an owner Trance has already assigned — Zen's space animation, Phase 7's calendar, Phase 5's new-tab button, the tab strip — and 'ambient motion' cannot be specified, built or accepted.

mods.name: SuperPins
mods.notes: Two of eighteen behaviours survived investigation: sticky pinned tabs (CSS) and lazy pinned tabs (browser.sessionstore.restore_pinned_tabs_on_demand, surfaced not reimplemented). Grid layout dropped per user, confirming grid-count=1 in their profile. Does not patch ZenPinnedTabManager.

mods.name: Tab Closing Bubble Animation
mods.notes: The one Phase 6 behaviour that genuinely cannot be CSS. Clean-room: TabClose rather than a MutationObserver, Web Animations through TranceMotion rather than keyframes plus a timer, one getBoundingClientRect per burst rather than one per bubble.

mods.name: Transparent Zen
mods.notes: Same author as the Zen Internet extension. Chrome transparency only — Zen Internet owns content-area transparency.

mods.name: Unloaded Tabs
mods.notes: Sole owner of the unloaded-tab appearance, absorbing SuperPins' competing strike-through and dimming knobs. Attribute-driven; no observer.

mods.name: Zen Compact Transparent Mode
mods.notes: Becomes the 'compact' surface preset, not a second blur stack.

mods.name: Zen Context Menu
mods.notes: Thirty-two hide-toggles dropped under §8.2; the workspace-colour menu tint kept. Its requirement that macOS native context menus be turned off became an opt-in pref that is off by default, because that trade is real (ADR-020).

mods.name: Zen Custom URL Bar
mods.notes: Eight prefs became two. Only the page-recede effect survived: the colour and radius work belongs to TranceSurfaces' overlay region, and the page-scaling default was already off in the mod itself.

mods.name: Zen Folder Tree Connectors
mods.notes: Verdict changed NATIVE->PREINSTALL after the reimplementation landed (ADR-027). Trance did build it — trunk and elbows in CSS alone, by styling .zen-tab-group-start, with no script where the mod ships a .uc.js — and it could only ever be an approximation of someone else's line, because GPL-3.0 means no rule from it may be copied. Installing it is not copying it. Trance now draws no connectors of its own.

mods.name: Zen Library
mods.notes: Verdict changed NATIVE->PREINSTALL by its investigation (ADR-030). Ships in full, as the author's own build rather than as a Trance rewrite of it: 7,500 lines with no interval, no MutationObserver, no backdrop-filter and no infinite animation, and one static will-change as the only section 3 offence in it. Still unlicensed, so nothing may be copied and nothing is.
